test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sachin bought the first pen for ₹630 and the second pen for ₹722, respectively. He sells the first pen at 70% of the profit but the buyer bargains for the price, and he has to offer a 9% discount and the second pen at 71% of the profit. Find the total profit he had in this transaction (correct to two decimal places).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Profit = Profit from **Pen 1** + Profit from **Pen 2**.

Pen 1: CP = 630, SP before discount = 630 × 1.70. Final SP = (630 × 1.70) × 0.91.

Pen 2: CP = 722, Profit = 722 × 71% = 512.62.

Total Profit = [630 × 1.70 × 0.91 − 630] + 512.62.

Total Profit = 344.61 + 512.62 = 857.23.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹857.23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **CP₁** = ₹630, **CP₂** = ₹722, **Profit%₁** = 70%, **Discount₁** = 9%, **Profit%₂** = 71%.
Formulas: Profit = SP − CP | SP = CP × (100 + P%) ÷ 100 | Final SP = Marked Price × (100 − D%) ÷ 100.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b102427a8eaf3365fd175632fa1f8d1e0b8aeaf5bc85ead97020024a9345f27d.png] 
⇒ **Pen 1** MP = 630 + (70% of 630) = 630 + 441 = ₹1071.
⇒ **Pen 1** Final SP = 1071 − (9% of 1071) = 1071 − 96.39 = ₹974.61.
⇒ **Pen 1** Net Profit = 974.61 − 630 = ₹344.61.
⇒ **Pen 2** Profit = 71% of 722 = (71 × 722) ÷ 100 = ₹512.62.
⇒ Total Profit = 344.61 + 512.62 = ₹857.23.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹857.23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Markup and Discount Relationship

When a profit percentage is applied and then a discount is given, the effective multiplier is (1 + Profit%ᵢₙᵢₜᵢₐₗ) × (1 − Discount%).

Profit Calculation

Total profit is the sum of individual profits from each article: Total Profit = ∑ (SPᵢ − CPᵢ).
